name: integration
wording: the act that ends a cut: once the architect has accepted that the cut realized its meaning, the lead joins its change to the project's shared line of work and records the integration in the ledger; it ends the cut's freeze, is final whatever its work packages' last statuses, and anything left unfinished becomes future work, never an open state of the cut.
reason: Record corrections, 2026-10-13: an independent architect read the design record cold and found settled decisions contradicting the current design, terms used but never defined, and concepts that disagree; the operator asked for the corrections to be applied. Integration was used throughout (freeze, ledger, 0149) but never defined, and merging read as the same act as release.
